notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone ![/b]
Anouncing some fixes improving the game experience.

[list]
[*] The controller works with QWERTY keyboard.
[*] The choice can be made letting you finish the game.
[*] Linked icon will now disappear.
[/list]

For the player who started the game at launch, we recommend to start over, it will reset properly !

We truly hope those fixes will give you satisfaction and we love reading your feedbacks on the game !
